strongest_angle: Explore how MTR Corporation applied a heavy-structure skidding method for the first time worldwide to a heavy-rail project over the operating Tuen Ma Line viaduct at Hung Shui Kiu Station, handling two main structures weighing 10,000 tons each.

key_facts.fact: Hung Shui Kiu Station is located between Tin Shui Wai Station and Siu Hong Station on the existing Tuen Ma Line.
key_facts.source_name: MTR Hung Shui Kiu Official Site

key_facts.fact: Each of the main structures for Hung Shui Kiu Station will be 210 metres long, 15 metres wide and weigh approximately 10,000 tons.
MTR Corporation will use a skidding method—the first worldwide for a heavy-rail project—to build Hung Shui Kiu station by 2030.
Stage 2 of the Hung Shui Kiu Station construction, scheduled for Q1-Q3 2027, involves station skidding and connection with the Tuen Ma Line.
key_facts.source_name: MTR Hung Shui Kiu Official Site
